author: Fanatic
text:
My view on this QM.

In Read the Market article from marketpedia we know that in general we should look at "HTF and know where price is coming from and going to, and the PA past and present in all the TFs, from the Monthly down."

So from where is price comming from?

Price CP to Supply and strongly react on it.

For me it is hard to predict what price will do next,

so I thiink it safer to watch QM level on LTF for reaction or wait for:

Ifmyante wrote: We look for engulfs of important decision points. The engulfs are strengthened by FTRs, putting caps on price. Basically it's all as simple as that:)

author: fxdaytrader
text: What is an "important" decision point? A lot of people are marking up FTR's based on engulfs of swing H/L's. Are they all created equal?

author: Fanatic
text:
I'm not an expert, but when I analize my failed trades I often see that HTF PA shows other price direction than LTF PA, so now I try analize LTF PA in context of HTF and don't blindly give an label DP, FTR.

So my answer to your question, no,they are not all created equal. But I would like to see an opinion of someone more experienced.

author: benhur
text:
Ranganus

You spot the Quasimodo pattern well. But like any other pattern it is more important to acknowledge the context of the pattern. The Quasimodo and any other reversal pattern we want to see occurring as a reaction to extreme levels (SD / SR).

In your next submission of the QM homework, please research only the formation around the extremes.
